args.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. ONE NEW KFB cartoon claymation ink monster character sheet, LANDSCAPE three columns by two rows, EXACTLY SIX complete unique actors, real transparent PNG. Request a native 3072x2048 sheet for higher-detail source use if supported; preserve 3:2 landscape aspect ratio. Do not merely enlarge an existing image.
The two input PNGs are STYLE REFERENCES ONLY: first for rounded whole dark ink body, subtle purple-black modeled plasticine, thick clay lids and rich soft sculpting; second for beautifully modeled wood/leather/metal/fabric props. This is a NEW FAMILY, not an edit, no copied hats, wings, feathers or repetitive faces.

Theme: absurd-surreal Confederate army soldiers of the US Civil War, Southern-Western period military costume vibe, satirical fictional fantasy creatures with varied ranks, temperaments and clear iconic equipment. Grey and faded butternut kepis, battered campaign hats, yellow piping, restrained brass rank/collar details and leather straps. No real person likeness. Expressive theatrical caricature of military bureaucracy and personal temperament. No flags, slogans, lettering or scene.

EVERY actor remains a WHOLE upright footless ink blob: large continuous charcoal-violet goo body with broad soft rounded asymmetrical lobes, face directly in blob, occasional small contained detached ink drops, two stubby rounded goo hands. Costume is partial collar/cuffs/straps/short cloth panels, not a fully clothed human torso. No human legs, feet, severed bust, fur or pointy spines. Rounded tangible hand-sculpted plasticine, fine finger impressions and handmade seams. Unusual offbeat cartoon personality, avoid generic Pixar humans/mascots.
EYES ALL: clearly WHITE/IVORY sclera around small RED iris and BLACK pupil. Thick fully violet clay eyelids. No glowing all-red eyeballs. Different facial structures, gaze and mouth designs; irregular ivory teeth if shown; no six grins or dangling tongues.

TOP LEFT — male-read pompous general. Broad heavy pear-shaped blob, heavy folded lids, weary superior side-eye, one pushed-out crooked lower lip, a single irregular lower tooth. Large battered grey campaign hat with a modest gold cord, small grey shoulder tabs with brass stars. Holds ONE short brass spyglass pressed low against his own belly, viewing nobody through it. He appears affronted that the distant situation has failed to improve. Standing frontally, body substantial.
TOP MIDDLE — female-read cavalry sergeant. Tall hooked bean silhouette, subtle lashes and single compact clay side curl, grey kepi tipped sideways, yellow cuff detail and small simple chevron cloth badge. Delighted reckless confidence, eyes look to side with one lid lifted high, broad lopsided toothy smile, mouth relatively shallow. Holds ONE short thick curved cavalry saber upright beside her own blob, entire blade contained in cell; hilt visibly gripped. No raised arm crossing cell.
TOP RIGHT — male-read nervous infantry private. Round dumpling with two blunt crown lobes beside a crumpled butternut cap. Wide white eyes fixed DOWN at his weapon, lips tightly squeezed around a disobedient upper tooth, little trembling lower lip; comic dread, no open round shouting mouth. Hugs ONE short cartoon percussion musket upright, simple wood stock, steel single barrel, visible little hammer, ramrod tucked against stock. Few straps, tiny canteen at side. Complete self-contained silhouette.
BOTTOM LEFT — male-read artillery captain. Very wide low bean, one long hooked goo lobe at top, battered grey kepi, orange-yellow collar tab. Deeply exhausted half-lidded downward eyes, compressed sideways grimace showing three unequal teeth, huge heavy lower lip. Holds ONE smooth black cannonball in one hand and ONE short fat wooden rammer with rounded swab head in the other, both low beside body. The ball is absurdly treated as a delicate responsibility. No cannon, floor or crouch.
BOTTOM MIDDLE — female-read quartermaster lieutenant. Compact near-square soft lobed blob, two short crown bumps, subtle lashes, tiny grey kepi and small brass collar bars, butternut shoulder cloth. Narrow suspicious gaze looking upward, one lifted skeptical brow, pursed asymmetric tiny mouth with one offset tooth. Hugs ONE dented rectangular tin ration box shut against her belly, ONE oversized brass key hooked over its latch, clear goo hands. Gleefully possessive officious attitude, not a repeated angry grin. No letters on tin.
BOTTOM RIGHT — male-read drummer corporal. Top-heavy teardrop with offset droplet lobes, oversized drooping grey forage cap and small brass buttons. Ecstatic full-body enthusiasm at peak beat, mismatched wide white eyes glancing up, cheek compressed by very broad irregular laughing mouth, only four uneven teeth. Small cream rope-tension drum strapped against lower blob, two thick wooden beaters held angled inward within own cell. No flying punctuation, tongue or motion lines.

COMPOSITION / SCALE must be correct in this FIRST image: uniform 3x2 grid, no visible gridlines. Each actor complete with own equipment inside its own equal cell. Match BODY height across all six, roughly70% of cell height excluding hat/weapon; full silhouettes85-90% of cell height maximum, clear margins on all four sides. Preserve large body size in bottom row. At1536x1024-equivalent each full actor target440-455px tall with at least24px outer margin and24-40px transparent gaps across both central column seams and row seam. At3072double those pixel measures. Wide characters and diagonal props fit by design rather than globally shrinking the sheet afterwards. Nothing overlaps or touches neighboring cells. No background, terrain, shadow disc, matte, checkerboard or vignette. Actual alpha-zero transparency outside characters, fully opaque character interiors, clean antialiased edges. Soft upper-left studio light only on character volumes. No text/watermark.

size_note: Requested3072x2048, actual1536x1024; no claim of native3072 or individual catalogue masters.
